image_description: A low-resolution, selfie-style photograph taken from the audience of a concert. The foreground features a man with blond hair and a mustache looking at the camera. The background shows an elevated stage with two musicians performing (one playing guitar, one singing/playing bass). Above the stage is a complex lighting rig with purple lights. A large banner hangs in the back. The image exhibits significant digital compression artifacts and pixelation.

The truss structure appears slightly warped and inconsistent in perspective, with some lights floating without clear attachment points.
